name: design
title: Design System & UI/UX
summary: Design-system engineering: tokens as the single source of truth (color, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion), typography and color with WCAG-passing contrast, layout/grid, accessibility as a gate, a motion system (framer-motion), mandatory component states, and the tooling (ui-ux-pro-max, 21st.dev catalog/AI/registry, shadcn/Tailwind, dataviz).
mandatory_tests: Contrast passes WCAG 2.2 (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large/UI) in BOTH light and dark
Every interactive element is keyboard reachable with a visible focus ring
No layout shift: all media/embeds have explicit dimensions (CLS < 0.1)
validations: Design tokens are the single source of truth — no magic values in components
Light AND dark themes both defined and validated
Type scale + font pairing justified; measure 45-75ch
One spacing scale; consistent grid; mobile-first responsive
Loading / skeleton / empty / error / disabled states specified per component
Motion has a duration + easing scale; purposeful, never gratuitous
Existing components/tokens reused (catalog checked) — no duplicates
Design does not regress Core Web Vitals (LCP/CLS)
